title: UNIMAX: FAIRER AND MORE EFFECTIVE LANGUAGE SAMPLING FOR LARGE-SCALE MULTILINGUAL PRE-TRAINING

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the disparity in model performance across high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages (e.g., Yoruba) using multilingual benchmarks like TyDi QA and WMT21. It proposes a sampling method to mitigate the dominance of head languages and improve fairness for tail languages.

In Appendix B, the paper calculates 'representation ratios' by comparing the proportion of a language in the training data to the proportion of its native speakers in the world population, identifying systematic underrepresentation of non-European populations.
